data.title: Order to cut back your hedge
data.summary: The district office (Landratsamt Beispielkreis) ordered you in a letter dated 29 June 2026 to cut your hedge back to the property boundary because it extends up to 1.20 m into the pavement. The work is requested within three weeks after the decision becomes final.
data.explanation: The authority says your hedge blocks the pavement and the view at a junction, and requires you to cut it back to your property line. You may object (Widerspruch) to this decision; the app shows until when. The objection must be filed in writing, electronically or recorded in person at the Landratsamt. If you don't object, the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), and the three-week period for the work then starts. Consider seeking advice if you disagree.

items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
